evidence.ACL: The anterior cruciate ligaments are almost complete torn; midsubstance.
evidence.MCL: The medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: In the medial compartment, intra-meniscus increased signal without reaching the surface; contusions at posterior part of body to posterior horn.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: complex tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus with suspect for flip of the meniscus to intercondylar region.
evidence.Medial OA: There is diffuse low grade chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along weight-baring medial femoral condyle.
evidence.Effusion: Minimal amount of right knee effusion is present.
evidence.Contusion: There is no fracture or bone contusion.
evidence.Fracture: There is no fracture or bone contusion.
